desc:
🔴 REC

Soft launch to get analytics, expect lots of bugs - me the dev lol

Testing bots on temporarily

One gun. One life. No crosshair.

RO-CAM is a 6v6 shooter that plays like helmet-cam footage. The camera shakes, reloads take both hands, and if you want to know how many rounds you have left, you pull the mag and look.

▸ ELIMINATION: die and you watch the rest through a teammate's camera. First to 4 rounds.
▸ TDM, FFA, GUN GAME for when you just want to shoot.
▸ ZOMBIES: vote it in, then try to last in a ghost town at night. Most squads don't.
▸ 30+ GUNS. Everyone starts with a Hi-Point. Earn the rest.
▸ SQUAD UP in the lobby and you always land on the same team.
▸ VOTE the map, and day or night. Night means flashlights. They can see yours too.
▸ Warm up on the range. Dress your operator: kits, patches, helmets, vests.

🎁 Join "shlop games" for +10% Marks (linked below)
⭐ VIP: 2x Marks.

BETA. Things will break. Tell us in the Feedback tab, we read all of it.
